findings.reason: the node must pick a mechanism §7 does not give it, and the two available are both wrong here — marking whole modules silently drops non-browser tests from the standing suite the section exists to protect, and per-test source inspection reintroduces exactly the source-reading §5 of this plan removes.
findings.text: §7 requires the `browser` marker to be "applied once in `tests/conftest.py` by the harness rather than test by test", but `installed_browser_or_skip` (tests/spa_browser_harness.py:539) is a plain function called at test runtime from ~29 modules that also hold non-browser tests (tests/test_build.py carries 24 tests with 1 browser call; tests/test_spa_graph_authority.py 11 tests with 2), and §7's write paths exclude those modules, so a collection-time conftest hook has no signal to identify the tests that reach the harness

findings.reason: the measure would go green on exactly the partial marking that leaves the population in the budget-blowing suite, which is the failure §7's hold exists to prevent; it should assert the marked population equals the dispatch-built population id-for-id.
findings.text: the done-when asserts "a test reaching the harness carries the marker", an existential a single marked test satisfies, while the deliverable is "Every test that reaches `installed_browser_or_skip`", so a node can pass the measure with one marker and leave the other ~55 browser tests in the standing suite
